decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of the original planning permission reference 01378/B/P1 dated 19/05/2016.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (15033/TP/001 Rev D, 15033/TP/002, 15033/TP/004, 15033/TP/005, 15033/TP/006 Rev A, 15033/TP/007, 15033/TP/009, 15033/TP/010, 15033/TP/011, 15033/TP/012, 15033/TP/014 Rev A, 15033/TP/015 Rev B, 15033/TP/016 Rev A, 15033/TP/017,  684.19.01, 684.TS.02, 23252/EX/001, Condenser Specification picture, Planning Statement dated 05/02/2016, Design, Access and Landscaping Statement dated February 2016, Transport Statement dated January 2016, Energy Statement dated 28/01/2016, Construction Environment Management Plan dated 28/01/2016, Air Quality Statement dated February 2016, Flood Risk Assessment dated 02/02/2016, Geo-Environmental and Geotechnical Report for Units 2-3 & 6-7 Space Waye reference no. P8978J590 dated 03/02/2016, Geo-Environmental and Geotechnical Report for Unit 27 Central Way reference no. P8978J589 dated 03/02/2016, Ecological Appraisal dated 26/01/2016, External LED Lighting Assessment dated 21/01/2016 and Landscape Management Schedule dated 29/01/2016 received on 17/02/2016, And 15033/TP/020 and 15033/TP/021 received on 26/02/2016, And 684.TP.01, 15033/TP/022 Rev A, 36481-001-005, Three Solar PV Feasibility Tables, BREEAM 2014 Preliminary Assessment dated 10/03/2016 received 17/03/2016, And 15033/TP/003 Rev L and 36481-001-006 received on 04/04/2016, And Drainage Assessment Form dated 05/04/2016, 14-130/301 Rev T4, 14-130/302 Rev T5 and 15 drainage calculation documents received on 05/04/2016, And Remediation Method Statement received on 12/04/2016. 
15033/TP/003M, 15033/TP/019A, 15033/TP/023A. Received: 26th July 2017. 
15033/TP/018 F, 15033/TP/013 E, 15033/TP/008 E. Received: 17th August 2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of industrial units hereby approved shall be implemented in accordance with submitted plans 15033/TP/020 and 15033/TP/021 and sample materials.
Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall not be carried out other than in accordance with the submitted Construction Management Plan for the full duration of the construction period.

Condition : 5 - All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plan 684.19.01. The works shall be carried out prior to the occupation of any part of the development or in accordance with the programme agreed with the local planning authority

Condition : 6 - The landscape management of the site shall be implemented in accordance with the Landscape Management Schedule hereby approved for the period of 5 years unless otherwise agreed in writing

Condition : 7 - If within a period of five years from the date of the planting of any tree, that tree, or any tree planted in replacement for it, is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, or becomes, in the opinion of the local planning authority, seriously damaged or defective, another tree of the same species and size as that originally planted shall be planted at the same place, unless the local planning authority gives its written consent to any variation

Condition : 8 - In this condition "retained tree" means an existing tree which is to be retained in accordance with the approved plans and particulars; and paragraphs (a) and (b) below shall have effect until the expiration of (5 years?) from (the date of the occupation of the building for its permitted use).

(a)	No retained tree shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed, nor shall any retained tree be topped or lopped other than in accordance with the approved plans and particulars, without the written approval of the local planning authority.  Any topping or lopping approved shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard[3998 (Tree Work)] or any other BS replacing.

(b)	If any retained tree is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, another tree shall be planted at the same place and that tree shall be of such size and species, and shall be planted at such time, as may be specified in writing by the local planning authority.

(c)	The erection of fencing for the protection of any retained tree shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved plans and particulars before any equipment, machinery or materials are brought on to the site for the purposes of the development, and shall be maintained until all equipment, machinery and surplus materials have been removed from the site.  Nothing shall be stored or placed in any area fenced in accordance with this condition and the ground levels within those areas shall not be altered, nor shall any excavation be made, without the written consent of the local planning authority.

Condition : 9 - Prior to first occupation of each unit, the shower facilities within each building and cycle parking shall be installed in accordance with the approved details (as set out in plan 15033/TP/022 A, 15033/TP/003 Rev L, 15033/TP/010, 15033/TP/005 and 15033/TP/014 Rev A) and shall be maintained thereafter for the lifetime of the development solely for their designated use.

Condition : 10 - Prior to first occupation of each unit, the car parking, including disabled parking and electric charging points, the new access points and servicing yards shall all be installed in accordance with the details specified on plan 15033/TP/003 Rev L and shall be maintained thereafter for the lifetime of the development solely for their designated uses. An additional 10% of the car parking for each unit shall be provided as passive electric charging points prior to occupation of each unit.

Condition : 11 - The premises shall be used for B1(c), B2 and/or B8 use and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class B of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 12 - The office floorspace contained within the development hereby approved shall be used only as offices ancillary to the main use of the premises as B1(c), B2 and/or B8 use and shall not be used for any other purpose
Condition : 13 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 14 - The proposed external lighting shall be installed in accordance with the approved plans, 2352/EX/001 and External LED Lighting Assessment Report and no other external lighting shall be installed without the written prior approval of the Local Planning Authority
Condition : 18 - The drainage system as approved under planning reference 01378/B/P1(20) dated 04/09/2017 must be maintained for the lifetime of the development.
description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to install two additional louvres and reposition one louvre to Unit A, omit one louvre on Unit B and install two additional louvres to Unit C of planning permission 01378/B/P1 approved 19/05/2016 for the erection of three buildings for flexible Use Class B1(c) (light industry), B2 (general industry) and/or B8 (storage or distribution) purposes with ancillary B1(a) (office) floor space; service yards; vehicle and cycle parking; alterations to vehicular accesses; landscaping; boundary treatment; external lighting; plant and associated engineering works.
